card.name: Verbs after a singular he/she subject
card.fires_on: Verbs or nearby words in web prose where a single male or female person is the subject and a his/her/himself word is likely next. It fires on the word just before such a possessive or reflexive.

modes.label: Verb after a named person
modes.description: A verb right after a named man as subject, before his own work or ideas.
modes.example: He was also a great author who wrote numerous books<< detailing>> his zoological studies in a way anyone

modes.label: Verb after she or he
modes.description: A verb after a pronoun or name for one person, in narrative or quotes.
modes.example: She didn’t<< want>> to take photos of their commitment ceremony.

card.plain: It fires on words in a sentence about one person, where "his" or "herself" is likely to come next.
